messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — starting AWS/GCP/Azure publisher onboarding for PartnerCorp. We need a Terraform module, manifest entries, and the legal checklist. Who owns infra vs legal?
Oliver Park: I can own coordination. Samir, can you draft a TF module template + example .tfvars? I'll handle marketplace manifest updates.
Samir Patel: Yep. Quick q: PartnerCorp wants both AMI (AWS) and container-based listings (GCP/Azure). Do we have a preferred canonical artifact?
Maya Chen: They want AMI for AWS and container for GCP/Azure. Also trial SKU for 14 days.
Samir Patel: Ok. Draft TF snippet to start (very rough):
```hcl
module "publisher_onboard" {
  source     = "git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-modules.git//publisher"
  partner_id = "partnercorp"
  cloud      = "aws"
  sku        = "redwood-core"
}
```
Samir Patel: I'll add outputs for IAM role ARNs and marketplace offer IDs.
Sarah Li: Legal notes: we need explicit KMS key ownership declared, DPA signed, export control questionnaire completed, and a redlined EULA with indemnity/usage clauses. Also confirm whether PartnerCorp will host backups in their account or ours.
Maya Chen: Backups will live in partner-owned account; no cross-account replication without a follow-up.
Sarah Li: Cool. Also flag: if AMI includes pretrained model weights, we need a clause about allowed redistribution and export controls. I'll author a redline.
Oliver Park: I'll update the internal tracker (PR-342) and add a checklist item for marketplace SKU mapping + legal artifacts: https://rwd/internal/marketplace-tracker/PR-342
partner-bot: Checklist created and attached: https://rwd/internal/marketplace-checklists/1758004567 (created by Oliver Park) :white_check_mark:
Samir Patel: Adding an example packer build for the AMI so ops can reproduce:
```bash
packer build -var 'ami_name=redwood-pub-partnercorp' packer/ami.json
```
Samir Patel: And a .tfvars example for AWS:
```hcl
partner_id = "partnercorp"
region     = "us-west-2"
ami_id     = "ami-0abcd1234efgh5678"
sku        = "trial-core-14d"
```
Jordan Rivera: Ops note: IAM role naming convention = `redwood-pub-<partner>-role`. We'll publish a least-privilege policy in the module. I can add role creation + assume-role trust block to the module.
Maya Chen: Great. Sarah — can legal share the redline by EOD Friday? We need to get PartnerCorp to sign before we submit AWS listing.
Sarah Li: Acknowledged. I'll upload the redline and DPA stubs to Drive and ping here when ready. Expect initial redline by Friday EOD.
Oliver Park: Can we sync tomorrow at 10am PST for a short handoff (manifest, billing metering tags, and trial flow)? I'll send calendar invite.
Maya Chen: 10am PST works for me. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: I'll bring the TF module PR and packer AMI steps. Also will include sample marketplace manifest snippet for SKU/trial mapping.
Samir Patel: sample manifest snippet: `{"sku":"trial-core-14d","trial_days":14,"meter":"RedwoodSeats"}`
Sarah Li: FYI legal will need PartnerCorp company address, contact for compliance questionnaire, and export classification details for models included.
Maya Chen: I'll request those from PartnerCorp today.
Jordan Rivera: Once TF module PR is open, tag `@ops` and `@sec` for review of IAM and KMS policies.
Oliver Park: Thanks team. I'll collate action items and post an updated checklist after the call.
partner-bot: Calendar invite sent for 1758098400 (tomorrow 10:00 PST).
Maya Chen: Thanks all — we'll reconvene after the sync. :rocket:
